decisionLog.decision: Use one mandatory keyless pre-PR producer ordered OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and preserve paid API only as a separately requested operator facility
decisionLog.why: This removes the parallel-session API-key substitution, keeps the independent reviewer outside development context, permits only typed UNAVAILABLE failover, and preserves Verification Loop as the sole acceptance authority on WSL and Windows

decisionLog.decision: Keep the supported Gemini isolation flags and add a pinned-bundle CLI contract smoke instead of weakening the fallback
decisionLog.why: Gemini 0.49.0 source and real WSL/native-Windows help both advertise the disputed flags; enforcing that evidence in the producer turns future version drift into terminal UNVERIFIED before any review call

decisionLog.decision: Require positive transport evidence before classifying any post-launch CLI failure as UNAVAILABLE
decisionLog.why: Unknown non-zero exits can represent unsupported arguments or adapter/protocol defects; treating them as availability would silently bypass a broken earlier reviewer instead of stopping fail closed

decisionLog.decision: Permit the guarded PR CLI to update only its matching existing Draft through an observed-SHA force-with-lease
decisionLog.why: A reviewed single-commit amend must replace the previously observed Draft head without bypassing the receipt, maker, registry or pre-push gates; exact lease binding prevents overwriting an independently changed remote branch, and skipping an already-current push avoids an empty pre-push stream

decisionLog.decision: Use the existing bounded PR command timeout for the guarded push instead of a fixed 300-second child limit
decisionLog.why: The pre-push hook must finish the full fresh machine oracle; carrying a 300..3600-second positive budget fixes availability while preserving every hook, receipt, lease and exact-candidate check

decisionLog.decision: Distinguish an exact no-PR diagnostic from every GitHub PR lookup failure before selecting push mode
decisionLog.why: Network, auth or GraphQL failure cannot safely authorize the new-PR path; failing closed preserves the existing-Draft lease and prevents an ambiguous ordinary push

decisionLog.decision: Bind both the current symbolic branch and repository in every gh PR lookup
decisionLog.why: The installed GitHub CLI requires a branch when --repo is present; explicit validated coordinates make existing-Draft discovery deterministic and keep usage errors terminal

decisionLog.decision: Bind the accepted no-PR diagnostic to the exact validated current branch without whitespace normalization
decisionLog.why: A same-shape message naming another branch is not evidence that the active branch lacks a PR; exact coordinate and newline-policy binding prevents a substituted response from selecting the ordinary push path

decisionLog.decision: Ground the mandatory keyless checker as provider-neutral in the canonical feature-ledger row
decisionLog.why: The CI completeness guard maps the adopted cross-review frontier to that exact architectural property; adding it to F-06 restores Linux/Windows ledger coverage without changing behavior

decisionLog.decision: Adopt evidence-first coverage, non-erasable host union and a two-reviewer quorum for high/unknown risk inside the existing nine-point plan
decisionLog.why: Exact-candidate provenance cannot compensate for missing scale/business-invariant evidence or one model's blind spots; ADR-005 makes coverage and reviewer efficacy executable release gates without granting reviewers unsafe production access

decisionLog.decision: Amend GPG-003 to one fresh opposite-GPT reviewer while retaining evidence-first machine oracles and all nine plan points
decisionLog.why: A41/A42 showed the provider quorum made publication depend on unavailable subscriptions and Copilot transport formatting, while the PR #1326 false clean result was caused by missing scale/business-invariant evidence rather than reviewer count; ADR-006 preserves exact-candidate adjudication without blocking product work
